issue.title: Five ACE visual PNG tests fail deterministically on clean master in agent workspaces: external/linked repo panels and LLM Calls detail levels
issue.description: Five ACE visual PNG tests fail on a clean master tree in an agent workspace; three share the signature that a repo-role label is missing from the rendered agents panel. See the CI failure body for nodes, evidence, and effect on golden regeneration.

task_type_fields.why_not_flake:
Observed 2026-09-20 on host apollo in agent workspace sase_16 at master d949f060e (== origin/master), with `just fix-tui-screenshots`. Not intermittent: each node below failed in 3 of 3 runs on the same tree -- a full visual run, a targeted 7-file run, and a check-mode run (`just test-visual`) on a pristine tree with every local change stashed.

Failing nodes:

- `tests/ace/tui/visual/test_ace_png_snapshots_agents_external_repos.py::test_agents_external_repo_diff_file_panel_png_snapshot` -- `assert_page_svg_contains(page, "external repo")` fails (tests/ace/tui/visual/_ace_agents_png_snapshot_helpers.py:74) right after the same helper found `gh:pallets/click`, so the repo name renders but the "external repo" label does not.
- `tests/ace/tui/visual/test_ace_png_snapshots_agents_linked_repos.py::test_agents_linked_repo_diff_file_panel_png_snapshot` -- same signature: `assert_page_svg_contains(page, "linked repo")` fails right after `sase-core` was found.
- `tests/ace/tui/visual/test_ace_png_snapshots_agents_linked_repos.py::test_agents_commit_messages_panel_png_snapshot` -- also fails in the same run (assertion in the same helper; exact text not captured).
- `tests/ace/tui/visual/test_ace_png_snapshots_llm_calls.py::test_agents_llm_calls_panel_detail_level_png_snapshots` parametrizations `1-agents_llm_calls_panel_expanded_120x40` and `2-agents_llm_calls_panel_full_120x40` (the level-0 parametrization passes); failure signature not captured.

Root cause NOT established. The first three share one signature (a repo-role label absent from the rendered agent panel), which suggests one shared cause rather than three; a workspace-path-length truncation like sase-13u is one candidate, unverified.

Effect: `just fix-tui-screenshots` refuses to write ANY golden while a failing test is selected (`visual pytest failed; candidates were retained but goldens were not changed`), so anyone regenerating goldens on this host must deselect these nodes with `-k`, and their own goldens can then not be refreshed here.

Related, distinct: sase-13v (retry e2e nodes and two other agents-panel nodes), sase-x5 (agents-panel golden drift backlog), sase-13u (path truncation under the long agent basetemp).

payload.entry: LIKELY FIXED BY sase-12z.5 — re-verify before launching a worker. This report's base is master d949f060e (2026-09-20 07:34), which predates 9a56fc129 'fix(visual): integrate the metadata-only Agents default with the screenshot corpus' (phase sase-12z.5.2, on master since 10:02). That commit is exactly the repair for these five nodes: commit 5d158ad65 had changed the Agents detail default from secondary-larger to metadata-only, so the external-repo, linked-repo and commit-message File-panel flows and the expanded/full LLM Calls detail levels asserted on content that was no longer visible. 9a56fc129 makes those tests select File-larger / a visible secondary layout through the public view picker, and fixes a latent Textual dispatch bug (LLMCallsVisibilityChanged collapses to on_llmcalls_visibility_changed) with @on so LLM Calls layouts are selectable at all under the new default. Evidence from the sase-12z.5 land agent on 2026-09-20 at master 624a29ea7 (athena, workspace sase_29): a complete 'just test-visual' run is 972 passed / 1 skipped with created=0 updated=0 unchanged=709 stale=0 and a complete inventory, so all five named nodes pass and their goldens match. Not closed because this bead was observed on apollo in workspace sase_16 and links sase-13u (long-basetemp path truncation) as a candidate cause; I cannot rule out a host-specific signature that survives the fix. Re-run on apollo at current master first.

TRIAGE VERIFIED FIXED (2026-09-20, athena workspace sase_34, master ec7dbbfdf == origin/master), with one stated limit.

All five reported nodes pass under 'just test-visual' with unchanged goldens (5 passed, 1 skipped -- the skip is the level-0 LLM Calls parametrization, which this report already recorded as passing): test_agents_external_repo_diff_file_panel_png_snapshot, test_agents_linked_repo_diff_file_panel_png_snapshot, test_agents_commit_messages_panel_png_snapshot, and test_agents_llm_calls_panel_detail_level_png_snapshots parametrizations 1-agents_llm_calls_panel_expanded_120x40 and 2-agents_llm_calls_panel_full_120x40. Targeted run reported 'check clean', created=0 updated=0 unchanged=7 stale=0, so 'just fix-tui-screenshots' no longer refuses to write goldens for this reason. This is a second independent confirmation of 9a56fc129, after the sase-12z.5 land agent's full 972-passed visual run at 624a29ea7.

LIMIT OF THIS VERIFICATION: the report was filed on apollo (workspace sase_16, master d949f060e) and I verified on athena, so the residual apollo-specific hypothesis this bead recorded -- that a long agent-workspace basetemp truncates the rendered repo-role label the way sase-13u describes -- is not directly excluded. It is a hypothesis with no evidence behind it: the repaired signature (the metadata-only Agents default hiding the asserted content, fixed by selecting a visible secondary layout through the public view picker) is host-independent logic, and none of these five assertions match on a tmp path. If these nodes still fail on apollo at a master containing 9a56fc129, reopen with 'sase bead +1 sase-13y --verified-after-close' rather than filing a new bead; the separate long-basetemp class stays tracked by open sase-13u.

payload.close_reason: All five nodes pass at master ec7dbbfdf; fixed by 9a56fc129 (phase sase-12z.5.2). Verified on athena only -- see close note
